events.verdict: McRae (WAS) reaches around Burks (CLE) and makes contact to his front but he is able to move through the marginal contact.
Bryant (WAS) makes contact to the body of Osman (CLE) during his shot attempt near the rim.
McRae (WAS) maintains a legal pivot foot.
Nance Jr. (CLE) exits the paint within 3 seconds.
Payton II (WAS) and Sexton (CLE) engage and disengage without affecting each others ability to retrieve the loose ball.
Sexton (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position during Payton II's (WAS) shot attempt near the rim.
As Bryant (WAS) and Nance Jr. (CLE) attempt to retrieve the rebound, both players make contact with the ball and engage in marginal body contact.
RAR shows Payton II (WAS) reaches around Burks (CLE) and wraps his arm around the right hip/torso of Burks.
Osman (CLE) moves along Dekker's (WAS) path and he absorbs the body contact during his driving shot attempt.
Payton II (WAS) extends his arm into Burks (CLE) during the rebound and that contact causes him to deliver contact to Nance Jr. (CLE) which dislodges him from his legally obtained position.
Burks (CLE) and Bryant (WAS) engage and disengage without affecting each others ability to retrieve the rebound.
Brown Jr. (WAS) commits a take foul on Sexton (CLE).
Payton II (WAS) cleanly deflects the pass intended for Sexton (CLE).
Sexton (CLE) briefly holds Payton's (WAS) jersey but does not affect his ability to defend the pass.
Clarkson (CLE) makes contact with the ball during Brown Jr.'s (WAS) shot attempt near the rim.
Prior to making contact with the ball, McRae (WAS) makes contact to the right arm/shoulder of Sexton (CLE) and that contact affects his SQBR.
Osman (CLE) gives McRae (WAS) room to land on the jump shot attempt.
Brown Jr. (WAS) makes marginal contact to the arm of Hood (CLE) prior to Payton II (WAS) making clean contact with the ball.
Payton II (WAS) commits a take foul on Clarkson (CLE).
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Hood (CLE) moves his foot heel-to-toe to create space.
Burks (CLE) makes contact to the arm of McRae (WAS) during his drive which affects his ability to gather the ball.
McRae (WAS) holds Osman (CLE) by the waist which affects his SQBR as he attempts to break towards the ball during the inbound.
Bryant (WAS) commits a take foul on Osman (CLE).
Osman (CLE) reaches in and cleanly dislodges the ball from Brown Jr. (WAS) during his shooting motion on the jump shot attempt.
